evidence: Fetched excerpt: “BLACK FRIDAY SubManager+ deals · Nov 27–30, 2026”.

Product is an Apple-platform app, not VPN/hosting or a course.
uncertainty: Whether the in-app App Store price will match the US prices shown on the marketing page at checkout.
Family Sharing eligibility and regional availability were not independently verified.
aiReview.tagline: Apple-native tracker with a 2026 Black Friday unlock sale
aiReview.description: Tracks subscriptions on Apple devices with reminders and iCloud sync. Vendor page lists a Black Friday SubManager+ sale Nov 27–30, 2026.
pros: Official site states Black Friday SubManager+ deals for Nov 27–30, 2026.
App covers iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Vision Pro with iCloud sync.
Paid tier is described as a one-time purchase, not a recurring fee.
Free download with no ads is stated on the same page.
cons: Sale window is only four days (Nov 27–30, 2026).
Smart Import depends on Apple Intelligence and compatible devices.
Upgrade is completed in-app via Settings, not as a web checkout.

aiReview.summary: Official product page advertises a Black Friday lifetime-license sale for a desktop AI/cloud/SaaS cost monitor. The banner does not spell out a 2026 date window, so season year still needs a human check against the listed Nov–Dec 2026 window.
evidence: Official excerpt: “Black Friday: Lifetime … See plans” and pricing card “Black Friday, 50% off” on Solo Lifetime.
Footer includes “© 2026 CostGoat”; product described as privacy-first desktop monitoring with 75+ integrations.
Not VPN/hosting; sale window in source list ends 2026-12-01, after BF week start 2026-11-23.
uncertainty: Whether the live page currently states year 2026 or dates Nov 20–Dec 1, 2026.
Whether code FCBF26 is shown on the vendor site.
How long the Black Friday banner remains after Dec 1.
page content does not confirm a 2026 Black Friday / Cyber Monday deal; approve requires the fetched vendor page to state the current-season sale

aiReview.description: Privacy-first menu-bar app for Mac, Windows, and Linux that monitors AI credits, cloud usage, and SaaS renewals with local-first alerts.
pros: Vendor homepage labels a Black Friday lifetime-license offer and links to pricing.

Page describes macOS, Windows, and Linux clients, a 7-day trial without sign-up, and local-first credential storage.
cons: Fetched copy says Black Friday but does not explicitly state a 2026 sale window or end date.
Coupon code and exact Nov 20–Dec 1 window appear only in the third-party deal list, not in the excerpted vendor copy.

aiReview.summary: Vendor page advertises a launch coupon on the full AI visibility report through November 30, overlapping Black Friday week 2026, but does not label it as a Black Friday or Cyber Monday sale or state the year on the offer itself.
evidence: Fetched autx.ai excerpt: “Launch offer 20% off the full report through November 30 with code LAUNCH20.”
Page sample answer dated November 1, 2026 and method note updated November 1, 2026.
Pricing table: free check vs one-time full report; Stripe checkout with prefilled promo.
Rubric requires explicit 2026 BF/CM wording on the vendor page for approve.
uncertainty: Whether the vendor intends this launch coupon as a 2026 Black Friday / Cyber Monday campaign.
Whether the November 30 end date is in 2026 on the offer banner itself.
Whether the deal will still be active at directory rebuild time.
page content does not confirm a 2026 Black Friday / Cyber Monday deal; approve requires the fetched vendor page to state the current-season sale
aiReview.tagline: See if AI models name your local business
aiReview.description: Run a free check or buy a full report on whether AI assistants name and recommend your business, with a launch coupon through November 30.
pros: Official homepage documents a launch coupon code for the full report through November 30.
Product is a software SaaS report for AI search visibility, not hosting or VPN.
Page describes a free no-signup check plus a one-time paid full report with refund terms.
Sale window on the page extends through November 30, which overlaps Black Friday week 2026.
cons: The vendor copy calls it a launch offer and never mentions Black Friday or Cyber Monday.
The offer line does not print the year 2026; season year is only implied by other page dates.
Deal listing in third-party roundups cannot be used as confirmation of a BFCM campaign.

# The DynamoDB and OpenSearch GUI with real SQL& your AI agent

A local-first desktop client for DynamoDB and Amazon OpenSearch. Real SQL with joins and aggregations, visual editing, and an AI agent on your own Bedrock keys or the Claude or ChatGPT plan you already pay for — your table and index data never goes through our servers.

[Download for Linux](https://dynotable.com/api/download/deb)[Read the docs](https://dynotable.com/docs)

Free 30-day trial, no credit card — then the Free plan with no time limit.

evidence: Official excerpt: “Black Friday … BF2026 Copy Ends Dec 6” linking to /pricing.
Features listed: summaries, transcripts, mind maps, ask, translation, Notion/Readwise/Obsidian.
Download links for App Store and Android APK; MCP/docs pages exist.
Sale end 2026-12-06 is after BF week start 2026-11-23.
uncertainty: Exact annual vs monthly terms and whether the discount applies on every renewal without visiting /pricing checkout.
Whether BF2026 is required at checkout or auto-applied.
page content does not confirm a 2026 Black Friday / Cyber Monday deal; approve requires the fetched vendor page to state the current-season sale

Paid plans include a 7-day free trial and some free browser tools.
cons: Homepage excerpt does not spell out the full Nov 16 start date listed in third-party roundups.
Core product is a listener app; developer tooling is secondary.

pros: Vendor site documents a free forever core helpdesk with unlimited seats and pay-per-resolution AI.

cons: Fetched homepage and pricing pages do not mention Black Friday, Cyber Monday, 2026, or a coupon code.

evidence: Source sectionPath is Courses & Books; product is training labs and certifications.
Excerpt shows 70% Off on launchpads and certs plus Apply Coupon, with no BFCM 2026 wording.
Rubric requires reject for courses/books and forbids approve without explicit 2026 BF/CM on the vendor page.
uncertainty: Whether the on-page coupon is a seasonal 2026 BFCM campaign versus a standing promo.
Exact sale start and end dates are only in the unlicensed deal-list table, not the vendor excerpt.
page content does not confirm a 2026 Black Friday / Cyber Monday deal; approve requires the fetched vendor page to state the current-season sale

cons: The listing is categorized as courses and books, which the directory should reject.

Sale dates in the curated list are not confirmed on the vendor page itself.

# Outlier pricing

Last updated 2026-11-20

By Matthew Kerr · founder, Outlier

Start with Free for everyday chat on your Mac. Choose Pro for the other four model tiers and every feature. Both plans run local AI on your own Mac. There is no monthly plan and no token bill.

## Free: Nano and Lite

Free costs $0 and stays free. It is for everyday private chat, with no account needed. It includes:

*   Nano 4B and Lite 9B.
*   Local chat and saved sessions.
*   The model picker and model downloads.
*   An 8K context window per conversation.

Nano needs 6 GB of memory and Lite needs 12 GB. Both fit a 16 GB MacBook
